title: ITIL 4 Managing Professional - ITIL 4 Specialist: Drive Stakeholder Value (DSV)
overview: The ITIL DSV course focuses on the customer journey and interactions, ensuring that IT professionals understand how to engage stakeholders, improve customer satisfaction, and deliver valuable services. It emphasizes the importance of customer experience, stakeholder engagement, and value co-creation.
audience: Consultants involved in stakeholder and customer relations
methodology: Lectures and Presentations: Deep dives into customer journey mapping.
Case Studies: Real-world examples of stakeholder engagement.
Interactive Sessions: Discussions and role-plays for stakeholder management.
Assessments: Quizzes and practice exams for certification preparation.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Learn how to map the customer journey and improve customer experience.
Understand stakeholder needs and manage their expectations.
Develop skills in demand management and service co-creation.
Prepare for the ITIL DSV certification exam.
